entry_points: User path: TalentMicroButton OnClick -> ToggleCollections() (FrameXML/MainMenuBarMicroButtons.xml:265; ToggleCollections defined at FrameXML/UIParent.lua:655). There is no keybinding (no loose Bindings.xml; stock TOGGLETALENTS -> ToggleTalentFrame which in Ascension's UIParent.lua:646 only handles pet talents) and no slash command.

UnitClass / UnitClassBase return 4 values and non-stock tokens: GlobalOverwrites.lua:87-96 wraps both to return (name, token, Enum.Class[token], Enum.ClassMask[token]); IsCustomClass()/IsDefaultClass()/IsHeroClass() need the native to answer 'HERO' for classless characters and the CoA token (BARBARIAN..SPIRITMAGE, ids 12-32, masks 0x800..0x80000000) for CoA characters. Stock UnitClassBase exists in 12340 but returns stock tokens only; an unknown class byte yields a nil token -> Enum.ClassMask[nil] = nil -> bit.band(x, nil) error inside IsCustomClass at Collections.lua:4/12/37/78/133. The shim must override the NATIVE UnitClass/UnitClassBase (not just the wrapper) before FrameXML/Util/GlobalOverwrites.lua runs, and the answer must be right at addon-load time (see notes on tab-set freezing).

Button/CheckButton:SetEnabled(bool): used by TabSystemTabMixin on every select/enable; not a 12340 native (string scan) - provided by SharedXML/TypeExtensions/Button.lua via GetButtonMetatable()/GetCheckButtonMetatable(), which are themselves Ascension-exe natives. Same for Region:SetShown/ClearAndSetPoint/SetPointOffset (Region.lua) and Texture:SetAtlas (Texture.lua) via GetFrameMetatable()/GetTextureMetatable(). The shim must supply the four metatable getters (or pre-extend the metatables itself) before compat/SharedXML loads.

GRAY_FONT_COLOR / YELLOW_FONT_COLOR / DISABLED_FONT_COLOR / HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR / RED_FONT_COLOR are used as ColorMixin objects (:GetRGB(), :WrapText()); stock FrameXML defines them as plain {r,g,b} tables. SharedXML/SharedConstants.lua redefines them with CreateColor and must load before this addon (it does in the compat layer).

UpdateMicroButtons() is called from insecure OnShow/OnHide/GoToTab and Ascension's version reads Collections:IsShown(); with stock FrameXML in the MPQ the call resolves to the stock function (no error) but the TalentMicroButton will not show PUSHED and TalentMicroButton OnClick still calls ToggleTalentFrame - the shim must hook both to open Collections.

UIPanelWindows['Collections'] carries the non-stock keys allowOtherPanels=true and dontCloseForNonCenterPanels=true, honoured only by Ascension's edited secure panel code (FrameXML/UIParent.lua:2033-2045). On stock FrameXML the entry (area='center', pushable=0, whileDead=1) still works, but opening another center panel (character sheet, spellbook) will close Collections and vice versa. The shim must add the UIPanelWindows entry itself; without it ShowUIPanel just calls frame:Show() and the panel will not be closed by Escape/other panels.
GetUIScale() (asc-fx, UIParent.lua:3969) and COA_AUTO_SHOW_TALENTS_LEVEL (asc-fx, Constants.lua:5) are Ascension FrameXML additions the compat layer must define; both are read in OnLoad.

XML attributes used: parentKey, motionScriptsWhileDisabled, PushedTextOffset, setAllPoints, and horizTile (on the inherited ThreeSliceButtonTemplate) are all present in the stock 12340 string table, so the stock XML loader accepts them. <OnEvent function="OnEventToMethod"/> (script 'function' attribute) could not be verified by string scan ('function' is too generic); if the stock loader ignores it, PLAYER_REGEN_DISABLED/PLAYER_LEVEL_UP handlers never run (no crash, combat auto-hide lost) - verify in P1 or have the shim SetScript('OnEvent', OnEventToMethod) on Collections after load.

notes: 1) What this addon is: a 260-line container. It owns no CA data and talks to no server; it is a TabSystemMixin frame ('Collections', 784x512, DIALOG strata) that hosts up to six LoD panels by NAME (panel strings resolved through _G at select time) and lazily loads them via SetPreClick -> *_LoadUI -> UIParentLoadAddOn. Every heavy native lives in the hosted addons; here the entire surface is Lua except GetCustomGameMode (mode bitmask), the four widget-metatable getters (needed by the compat SharedXML layer) and, for HERO characters only, C_Config.GetBoolConfig. 2) Tab set is FROZEN at OnLoad: SetupTabSystem (Collections.lua:26) evaluates IsCustomClass() and C_Player:IsHero() exactly once when the addon loads - which is at login, because AscensionUI.toc and Ascension_SkillCards.toc depend on it. For CoA characters it registers the 'CoATalentFrame' panel and omits the MysticEnchants tab; for others it registers 'CharacterAdvancement' and adds MysticEnchants; HeroArchitect/SkillCards exist only for HERO. In the DESIGN.md architecture the CoA class identity arrives from mod-ascension-ca over the addon channel AFTER login while the stock client sees the carrier class, so at OnLoad IsCustomClass() would be false and the panel would be built wrong (and PLAYER_LEVEL_UP auto-open never registered). The shim must either answer UnitClassBase correctly before addons load (per-character SavedVariable cache of the last CLASS message, or derive from the login class byte) or, on CLASS arrival, call Collections:RemoveAllTabs() (TabSystemMixin.lua:160) then Collections:SetupTabSystem() to rebuild - note SetupTabSystem re-runs TabSystemMixin.OnLoad which resets self.tabs/self.tabPanels and RegisterCallback state, so also re-register OnTabSelected (it does that itself at :31). 3) Tab ids are positional (AddTab order) and character-dependent; Collections.Tabs.<Name> is nil for absent tabs and GoToTab(nil) returns silently, so callers such as ShowSkillCards fail soft. 4) DISCREPANCY: FrameXML/UIParent.lua:594 calls Collections:SwapHeroArchitectTabToSkillCards(), which no file under this addon (or anywhere in the tree) defines; the reference Collections.lua is from a different revision than the captured UIParent.lua. It is reachable only for WildCard/Draft characters whose Tabs.SkillCards is nil (i.e. non-HERO in those modes) and would raise 'attempt to call method'. Out of scope for a CoA-first release; the shim may define it as a no-op or as RemoveTab(HeroArchitect)+AddTab(SkillCards). 5) Opening the panel on stock FrameXML: the user entry point is Ascension's edited TalentMicroButton (OnClick -> ToggleCollections, MainMenuBarMicroButtons.xml:265) and Ascension's UpdateMicroButtons pushes that button; both live in FrameXML which DESIGN.md keeps stock. The shim's compat/FrameXML must define ToggleCollections (copy of UIParent.lua:655-668, it uses IsCustomClass, UnitLevel, C_GameMode, HelpTip:Hide), re-point TalentMicroButton's OnClick (or hook ToggleTalentFrame/TOGGLETALENTS), hook UpdateMicroButtons for the pushed state, and add UIPanelWindows['Collections'] (UIParent.lua:57). No slash command or keybinding exists in Ascension for this panel. 6) Level gate: for CoA characters the CharacterAdvancement tab is SetTabEnabled(false) below COA_AUTO_SHOW_TALENTS_LEVEL=10 with tooltip format(FEATURE_BECOMES_AVAILABLE_AT_LEVEL, 10); ToggleCollections sends such characters to the Vanity tab instead. Matches the memory note that the CA panel gates on level 10 (ARCHIVE_LEVEL=80). Disabling the current tab triggers SelectFirstEnabledTab. 7) OnShow side effects to reproduce or tolerate: SetFrameLevel(MainMenuBarOverlayFrame:GetFrameLevel()+1) (stock frame), PlaySound(679), Draft:HideCards() if Ascension_Draft is loaded, UpdateMicroButtons(), tab enable/hide logic, HelpTip:Acknowledge('WARDROBE_CHANGE_TRANSMOG_HINT') which indexes the GLOBAL HelpTips table (FrameXML/HelpTips.lua, asc-fx) - if HelpTips is nil every OnShow errors after the tabs are set (the shim must at least define HelpTips = {} plus HelpTip.Pools via SharedXML/HelpTip.lua). 8) OnHide: PlaySound(680), HideCurrentPanel() (hides the active child by _G lookup), UpdateMicroButtons(). 9) Frame scale hack: if UIParent:GetEffectiveScale() > 0.9 the frame scale becomes 1-(scale-0.9); OnTabSelected resizes the container to the child's GetSize() (Vanity +80x50, Wardrobe tab row y=2) - children must have real sizes at select time. 10) Combat: PLAYER_REGEN_DISABLED -> HideUIPanel; the level-up auto-open waits for combat end via Timer.AfterCombat (needs the 'AscensionTimer' frame from SharedXML/Util/Timer.lua) then 2 s, then C_PopupQueue (needs MAX_ACHIEVEMENT_ALERTS from stock AlertFrames). 11) Sound: SOUNDKIT ids 679/680/681 must be mapped to igCharacterInfoOpen/igCharacterInfoClose/igCharacterInfoTab for stock PlaySound; TabSystemMixin:SelectTab also plays the tab sound (silent flag exists). 12) Art the pack must ship because patch-B is excluded: AwAddons\Collections\StoreCollection (backdrop), Interface\Common\WowTabAtlas (tab three-slice via AtlasInfo.lua; AtlasUtil:Unpack asserts on unknown names), Interface\common\WhiteIconFrame (icon border), custom icons INV_Chest_Awakening and inv_custom_ReforgeToken. 13) Load order the shim must guarantee before this addon: SharedXML (Mixin.lua, TypeExtensions with the 4 metatable getters, Enum.lua, SharedConstants.lua with CreateColor'd font colours and IsCustomClass/OnEventToMethod, ColorUtil, Pools, CallbackRegistryMixin, TabSystem/*, SharedTemplates.xml+lua (BorderIconTemplate), SharedPanelTemplates.xml+lua (ThreeSliceButtonTemplate/UIButtonMixin/ButtonControllerMixin), AtlasInfo.lua, SoundKit.lua, SharedOverwrites.lua, Timer.lua, HelpTip.lua, C_Hook.lua), then FrameXML compat (Constants.lua COA_AUTO_SHOW_TALENTS_LEVEL, Util/GlobalOverwrites.lua UnitClass wrappers, Util/GlobalFunctions.lua InGlue/GetMaxLevel, Util/C_Player.lua, Util/C_GameMode.lua, Util/C_PopupQueue.lua, Util/MysticEnchantUtil.lua stub, HelpTips.lua, the six *_LoadUI + ToggleCollections + GetUIScale + UIPanelWindows entry from UIParent.lua), plus the 14 GlobalStrings. luacheck_pack.py (DESIGN.md section 7) should whitelist Draft, ForcedPrimaryStatFrame and the seven panel frame names as late-bound. 14) Hosted-panel contract for the shim's own CA implementation: the panel must be a global frame named exactly 'CoATalentFrame' (CoA) or 'CharacterAdvancement' (others) with parent Collections, hidden by default, sized before first select; it is shown/hidden purely by Show()/Hide() from SelectTab/HideCurrentPanel (via SetShown), and its LoD addon is loaded by CharacterAdvancement_LoadUI on the tab's PreClick, so a shim that ships the CA panel non-LoD only needs that function to be a no-op that does not error. 15) Verified against the stock 12340 exe string table (C:\AzerothRealm\client\Wow.exe, sha256 aa63a575...): present - UnitClassBase, UnitClass, SetHorizTile/SetVertTile, SetMaskTexture, PlaySound, SetPortraitToTexture, IsOwned, HasScript, parentKey, motionScriptsWhileDisabled, horizTile, PushedTextOffset; absent - GetTextureMetatable, GetFrameMetatable, GetCustomGameMode, SetEnabled, UnitClassMask, InGlue.
